title: AE31006: Computer Application In Aero. Engineering
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Numerical solutions of linear and non-linear algebraic equations, ordinary
differential equations and partial differential equations; conceptual data
models, methods of organizing, storing and retrieving data, data structures;
Elements of modern artificial intelligence (AI) related techniques;
introduction to Genetic Algorithms and Artificial Neural Nets; Examples related
to Aerospace Engineering.
